pass_criteria.jitter: >=4/5 judges correct on b2j1 and b2j3, and b2j2 (polarity) within each other's confidence bands. failing this invalidates the session substrate

taper.roughness_polarity: >=4/5 judges select fid2_taper15 (uniform) as rougher on b2t1 -> polarity confirmed (heavy taper = smoother)
taper.line_character: >=4/5 judges select the heavy-taper side on b2t2 and b2t3 -> taper discriminable under calligraphic framing
taper.cross_cue: >=4/5 judges select b2_jit2 (jitter) as rougher on b2t4 -> jitter roughness dominates when cues conflict
taper.verdict_rule: line_character pass + roughness polarity pass -> promote taper to its own line_character axis with smoother polarity on roughness; line_character pass + roughness split (2/3) -> standalone axis, remove from roughness composite; both fail -> kill the taper candidate

grain.anchor_pass: 5/5 judges correct on b2g6 (0v14, extreme delta)
grain.jnd_floor: lowest 0-v-X pair with >=4/5 agreement gives the floor bracket; if 0v8 fails while 0v11 passes, floor is between 8 and 11
grain.local_jnd: 8v11 and 11v14 agreement gives the JND in the working range
grain.d_prime: b2g7 must yield >=4/5 'different' -> pilot miss was a which-is-more artifact, not a perceptual floor

pass_criteria.lighting: >=4/5 correct on b2l1 and b2l2 (corrected prompt validated); b2l4 agreement estimates the brightness JND near the top of the range
pass_criteria.general: any scored pair with a 50/50 judge split is a stimulus failure, not human noise: regenerate at higher parameter delta in the next batch

adaptive_rules.catch_fail: a judge answering >1 catch pair with a side choice instead of 'no difference' is excluded from aggregates; recruit a replacement to hold n=5
adaptive_rules.grain_fail: if 8v11 fails but 8v14 passes, the psychometric floor is between 11 and 14: next batch probes 11v13 and 12v14
adaptive_rules.lighting_fail: if 0.5v0.75 passes but 0.25v0.75 fails, lighting JND is above 0.25: next batch probes 0.5v1.0 (capped at substrate max)
adaptive_rules.stimulus_fail: 50/50 splits get regenerated at higher contrast next batch and logged as stimulus-quality data
adaptive_rules.convergence: two consecutive batches with agreement values inside each other's bootstrap CIs at target n ends the loop for that dimension; the plateau is the metric's honest ceiling

registry_consequences.taper_split: taper -> measurable only, removed from roughness composite
registry_consequences.lighting_fail: lighting_strength -> stays measurable, prompt/JND work queued
registry_consequences.grain_pass: texture_energy -> validated with floor bracket recorded
